ValidationRule.description: CCNA Frontline agents are not allowed to manually change the Status to Bottler Follow UP, they must click on the "Assign to Residing Bottler" Button
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c, "US"), $UserRole.Name = 'CCNA Frontline Agent', If(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Bottler Follow up"), If(CONTAINS(RIGHT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName,2),'BC')||OwnerId='00G5A00000476GH',TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status))<>"New" && ISCHANGED(OwnerId),TRUE) ,FALSE ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invalid Status - Change Status to New and click on - Assign to Residing Bottler Button...
